main_text.l: תֵּצְאִי exibitis, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. & 2. pl. m. Rad. יָצָא.
וַתֹּצִיאִי & eduxisti, vel xit, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. יָצָא.
תָּצוּר venaberis, vel tur, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. צוּר.
תְּצַוֶּה præcipies, vel et, fut. Piel, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. צָוָה.
תְּצוּמִי jejunabitis, fut. Kal, 2. pl. m. R. צוּם.
תָּצוּר obsidebis, vel bit, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. צוּר.
תִּצְּרִי custodies, vel et, pro תִּצַּר, & תִּצֹּרְנָה custodient, pro תִּצַּרְנָה; fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. ut & 3. pl. f. Rad. נָצַר.
תִּצַּיבֵנִי statues me, vel statuet me, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. aff. Rad. יָצַב.
תָּצִיג statues, vel et, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. יָצַג.
תַּצִּיל eripies, vel et, תַּצִּילֵנִי me, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. aff. Rad. נָצַל.
תְּצִינָה vastabuntur, fut. Kal, 3. pl. fæm. Rad. נָצָה.
תַּצִּיתוּ incendetis, fut. Hiph. 2. pl. m. Rad. יָצַת.
תְּצַלֶּינָה tinnient, pro תְּצַלֶּינָה, fut. Kal, 3. pl. f. Rad. צָלַל; vel potius est fut. Hiph. 3. pl. f. Rad. צָלַל.
תִּצַּלֶּינָה tinnient, Jer. 19.3. pro תִּצַּלֶּינָה, fut. Niph. 3. pl. f. Rad. צָלַל.
תִּצְפֶּינָה speculemini, vel entur, fut. Kal, 2. vel 3. pl. f. Rad. צָפָה.
תִּצְפְּצֵף pipias, vel at, fut. Piel, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. gem.

page.notes: The Hebrew vowel points and consonants are my best reading of a small, worn print. Forms marked by the printer's own spelling of the Hebrew may differ slightly from the scan. The first two entries on the right column's first line and the Latin "&" signs are as printed. Entries 1 and 2 of the left column are the first lines after the running heads; the page appears to continue an entry from the previous page only if the head word ה... is set at the top, which is not visible here. No marginal notes or footnotes are printed.
